business.name: Saha Agency
business.description: An independent insurance agency based in Woodbridge, Virginia, helping individuals, families, and businesses explore personal and commercial insurance solutions.

agency_reported_figures.note: Agency-provided figures. The presentation does not name the companies or specify the nature of each relationship; do not describe all of them as appointed carriers.

services.name: Home Insurance
services.description: Insurance for a home and related property, subject to covered risks, limits, exclusions, and deductibles.

services.name: Auto Insurance
services.description: Insurance options for personal vehicles, subject to the selected policy.

services.name: Commercial Auto
services.description: Insurance options for business vehicles and commercial transportation needs.

services.name: Business Insurance
services.description: Insurance options for business-related risks, depending on the business and selected policy.

services.name: Business Owners Policy
services.description: A package combining business property and liability protection, subject to eligibility and policy terms.

services.name: Workers’ Compensation
services.description: Coverage related to workplace injuries or illness, subject to the applicable policy and requirements.

services.name: Commercial Liability
services.description: Liability coverage options for businesses, subject to policy terms.

services.name: Professional Liability
services.description: Coverage options for claims related to professional services or advice.

services.name: Cyber Insurance
services.description: Coverage options related to cyber incidents, data breaches, and technology-related risks.

services.name: Professional E&O
services.description: Errors and omissions coverage options for professional services.

services.name: Bond
services.description: Surety solutions for contractual and professional obligations. Ask an advisor about the required bond.

services.name: Umbrella Insurance
services.description: Additional liability protection beyond underlying policy limits, subject to eligibility and policy terms.

services.name: Event Insurance
services.description: Protection options for eligible private, corporate, and special events against certain covered risks and unexpected situations. Coverage, limits, exclusions, and pricing depend on event details and the selected policy.

services.name: Commercial Property Insurance
services.description: Coverage options to help protect commercial buildings, property, and related business assets. Coverage, limits, exclusions, and pricing depend on business and asset details and the selected policy.

agency_support: Comparison of options from multiple insurance carriers

methods: Use the quote request form on the agency website
quote_request.note: The assistant cannot submit a quote request or calculate a premium. An advisor must confirm pricing, eligibility, and available coverage.
quote_request.process: Customers provide information needed for a quote or application. The insurance company reviews the information and determines available coverage, pricing, and policy terms. Business quotes depend on business details; event quotes depend on event details.

coverage_note: Protection depends on the specific policy, insurance carrier, covered risks, exclusions, limits, and deductibles.
